methodologyNote: OUTBOUND-ONLY (leave centre at a fixed time, earliest arrival everywhere) -- this project predates Liverpool's reverse_feed/many-to-one fix and it hasn't been backported, so unlike Liverpool or Sheffield this has NOT been checked for the direction-of-travel bug those fixes addressed (peak-direction timetabling can make outbound and inbound times genuinely different). No midnight-wrap or inf-averaging fixes either. On the plus side, the 1957 network (trams + buses, 'full_1957') is a REAL digitised timetable -- all 65 services of the winter 1956/57 Leeds City Transport timetable, transcribed from scans, ~8,650 weekday departures -- not synthetic like Manchester's. Modern comparison is DfT Bus Open Data only: heavy rail is deliberately excluded from BOTH eras (see this project's README), so this understates modern accessibility near stations (Cross Gates, Morley, Horsforth) and is neutral elsewhere. Transfer penalty 1 min (routing convenience -- real transfers cost far more). No coastline clipping (inland city, not needed).
